modules.summary: Pull-to-shoot gesture math. Pure functions: no DOM, no globals.
modules.notes:
Units: pointer positions and distance share one unit (pixels); ratios are 0..1.
Input: pointer start/current positions and track length (numbers); a ratio (number).
Output: pullRatio and shotStrength return 0..1; reachesMinPull returns a boolean.

modules.summary: Clamp a number into the range min..max.
modules.notes:
Input: value, min, max (numbers, min <= max).
Output: value limited to min..max; NaN in gives NaN out.
